about: Every row of team/rounds/2/research/LEGAL-PT.md (researcher, 18 November 2026), sections 1, 2.1, 2.2 and 2.3, in the research's own words, for the made-up example's admin. Not legal or tax advice: rules change and depend on each owner's situation; check the official text and a qualified professional. Text CC BY 4.0.

sectionTitles.2.2: Income tax (IRS) for a person who runs the AL

rows.rule: Decreto-Lei 128/2014 (Regime Jurídico da Exploração dos Estabelecimentos de Alojamento Local), amended several times and republished by DL 76/2024. Modalities: moradia (house), apartamento, estabelecimento de hospedagem (including hostel), quartos (rooms in the owner's home).
rows.sureText: high (that the regime exists and was republished); details below vary

rows.rule: Lei 56/2023 of 6 October 2023: suspended new AL registrations in apartments (autonomous fractions) outside low-density areas, made registrations expire and need renewal (five years, review in 2030), made them non-transferable, created the extraordinary contribution CEAL, let the condominium cancel an AL by a two-thirds vote, and gave a tax exemption to owners moving an AL to long-term renting.
rows.source: Turismo de Portugal business page (below); law-firm notes (Cuatrecasas, SRS Legal, PLMJ)

sources.label: Turismo de Portugal business page (below); law-firm notes (Cuatrecasas, SRS Legal, PLMJ)

rows.rule: DL 76/2024 of 23 October 2024, in force 1 November 2024: revoked the suspension of new registrations, the five-year expiry, the 120-day seasonal rules and (with DL 57/2024) the CEAL; made transfer of a registration the general rule again (limits possible in contention areas); gave municipalities the power to regulate AL by municipal regulation, with "áreas de contenção" and "áreas de crescimento sustentável"; created a provedor do alojamento local (an ombudsperson for disputes).

A "comunicação prévia com prazo" to the municipality, made through the Balcão Único Eletrónico (ePortugal); the establishment gets a number in the RNAL (Registo Nacional de Alojamento Local, kept by Turismo de Portugal). The municipality may oppose within 60 days, or 90 days in a contention area (DL 76/2024). The RNAL now also shows the validity date of the mandatory insurance.
rows.source: Turismo de Portugal page above; RNAL: https://rnt.turismodeportugal.pt/RNAL/

sources.label: Turismo de Portugal page above; RNAL:

rows.sureText: high (deadlines and insurance date); medium (portal names)

rows.rule: Every advert or listing must show the establishment's name and RNAL number (DL 128/2014). The site's invented homes should show a clearly fake number, e.g. "RNAL 00000/AL (demonstration)".

Contribuição extraordinária sobre o alojamento local (15% under Lei 56/2023): revoked by Decreto-Lei 57/2024 of 10 September 2024 (authorised by Lei 35/2024 of 7 August), with effect from 31 December 2023, so it was never due.
rows.checkedNote: Portal das Finanças links in search results; PDFs not opened

rows.rule: Since DL 76/2024 no condominium authorisation is needed for an AL in a residential fraction (it still is for a hostel). The condominium can no longer cancel the registration itself; it can oppose the AL by a reasoned resolution of more than half of the building's permilagem, on grounds of repeated, proven acts that disturb the building's normal use or residents' rest, and ask the mayor to decide on cancellation (the mayor may first seek an agreement, with or without the provedor). A condominium regulation may also restrict uses; check the building's title (título constitutivo).
rows.sureText: high for the 2024 rule; one law-firm note says two-thirds for changing the condominium regulation to forbid AL: low, check the text

rows.rule: Faro, Loulé, Tavira, Lagos and Vila do Bispo: I did not find or read a municipal AL regulation or a declared contention area for any of the five on 18 November 2026.
rows.sureText: unknown: check each câmara's "regulamentos" page and the Diário da República, 2.ª série

rows.rule: A multi-risk insurance (seguro multirriscos) with civil liability cover for damage to guests and third parties is mandatory (article 13.º-A of DL 128/2014, added by Lei 62/2018). Missing or invalid insurance is a ground for cancellation by the municipality (DL 76/2024).
rows.source: Turismo de Portugal page above; DL 128/2014

sources.label: Turismo de Portugal page above; DL 128/2014

rows.rule: The establishment must have a fire extinguisher and a fire blanket within reach, a first-aid kit, and visible information on the emergency number 112. Larger establishments fall under the general fire safety rules for buildings (DL 220/2008, SCIE).
rows.source: DL 128/2014 (article 13.º, as I recall it from the republished text; not opened today)

sources.label: DL 128/2014 (article 13.º, as I recall it from the republished text; not opened today)

rows.rule: Moradia and apartamento: at most 9 bedrooms and 30 guests; quartos: at most 3 rooms. (Some buildings allow more beds per room; sofa beds count.)
rows.source: DL 128/2014 article 11.º (from memory of the text and secondary guides; not opened today)

sources.label: DL 128/2014 article 11.º (from memory of the text and secondary guides; not opened today)

rows.rule: A complaints book in paper and the electronic complaints book (Livro de Reclamações Eletrónico) are mandatory, with the notice of its existence visible; the electronic one is at https://www.livroreclamacoes.pt
rows.sureText: medium (general rule for service providers; applies to AL)

rows.rule: Anyone who houses foreign citizens for payment must send an accommodation bulletin (boletim de alojamento) for each foreign guest within 3 working days of arrival, and record the departure, through SIBA (Sistema de Informação de Boletins de Alojamento). Portuguese guests are not reported this way. The body running SIBA moved from SEF to AIMA and the internal security system after 2023; sources disagree on which runs it now.
rows.sureText: high (3 working days); low (which body runs SIBA today, the fines)

rows.rule: House rules and how things work, in Portuguese and English (and further languages in some cases).
6% (reduced rate, mainland Portugal), CIVA List I, item 2.17. Madeira and the Azores have their own rates (not relevant here).
Cleaning or linen charged as part of the stay generally follow the accommodation (6%); separate services (transfers, tours, bike hire) may be at 23%.
rows.source: general VAT rule on ancillary services

sources.label: general VAT rule on ancillary services

rows.rule: Article 53.º CIVA: no VAT charged (and none deducted) while annual turnover in Portugal is at most €15,000. Revised by Decreto-Lei 35/2025 of 24 March 2025 (effect from 1 July 2025 per one source): the limit counts operations in Portugal only; exceeding the limit by more than 25% (that is, above €18,750) ends the exemption at once, otherwise from the next year.
The municipal tourist tax is collected for the municipality and shown separately; it is not part of the accommodation price for VAT.

AL income is business income (category B). Under certain conditions the owner may opt to tax it as property income (category F, flat 28% on rent less actual expenses, with reductions for long contracts that do not apply to AL).
rows.sureText: medium (cat B); low (cat F option conditions)

rows.rule: Allowed while gross annual business income is up to €200,000. Taxable income = gross receipts × coefficient.
0.35 (article 31.º, n.º 1, alínea h) CIRS)
0.50 for a house or apartment located in an "área de contenção" (from the 2020 State Budget law)
rows.sureText: high (rule); unknown whether any of the five municipalities has a contention area

rows.rule: 0.15 (hotel and similar activities)
With the 0.35 coefficient, expenses of at least 15% of gross income must be shown (on e-Fatura, or standard deductions); any shortfall is added to taxable income. Not applied to 0.50 and 0.15.
The coefficient is reduced by 50% in the first tax year of activity and by 25% in the second (article 31.º, n.º 10 CIRS), under conditions.
Taxable income joins the person's other income and is taxed at the progressive IRS rates for the year (rates change every year: take them from the year's State Budget).
rows.sureText: high (principle); no rate is quoted here

rows.rule: A non-resident owner pays IRS in Portugal on this income at rates for non-residents; not modelled.
If the operator is a company (IRC), different rules; not modelled.

formulas.title: Tourist tax for one booking
formulas.text:
```
nights = list of the stay's nights (local dates, arrival night to the night before departure)
payingGuests = guests aged 16 or over, minus exempt guests (resident, medical, ...)
rate(m, d) = per-night rate of municipality m on date d (table below), 0 if none
cap(m) = Faro 7, Loulé 5, others 0 (no tax)
taxedNights = first min(len(nights), cap(m)) nights
touristTax = payingGuests × Σ over taxedNights of rate(m, night)
```

Rates as data (effective dates matter; keep a `from` date so a rule change is a new row):

[
  {"municipality": "faro",  "from": "2024-11-01", "months": [3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10], "eur": 2.00, "cap": 7, "min_age": 16, "source": "Regulamento 1207/2024", "sure": "high; cap low"},

Example (Faro, 2 adults and 1 child of 10, 4 nights from 18 November): 2 × 4 × €1.00 = €8.00.

formulas.title: VAT on one booking
formulas.text:
```
price = accommodation price the guest pays, VAT included (excluding the tourist tax)
if owner.vatExempt53 (yearly turnover ≤ 15000):  vat = 0; net = price
else:                                             net = price / 1.06; vat = price − net
guestPays = price + touristTax
```

Exemption check over the year: `turnoverYear = Σ net` (or Σ price when exempt). If `turnoverYear > 15000` the exemption ends from the next year; if `> 18750` it ends at once (medium: check the date rule). Show a warning, do not switch silently.

Example: €480 for 4 nights, not exempt: net €452.83, VAT €27.17.

formulas.title: IRS estimate, simplified regime (category B)
formulas.text:
```
gross = Σ net accommodation receipts in the year (VAT and tourist tax excluded)
coef = 0.35 (house or apartment); 0.50 if in a contention area (none known in the five municipalities: default off); 0.15 for rooms or hospedagem
startYear factor: × 0.5 in the first year, × 0.75 in the second (optional toggle)
taxableAL = gross × coef × startYearFactor
if coef == 0.35: shortfall = max(0, 0.15 × gross − documentedExpenses); taxableAL += shortfall
irsAL ≈ taxableAL × marginalRate   (marginalRate is typed in by the admin, default 0.30, labelled "assumption: your IRS bracket")
```

Note on screen: "IRS is assessed on all your income for the year at progressive rates; this is a rough share for the holiday homes only."

Example: gross €20,000, coefficient 0.35, documented expenses €4,000 (more than 15% of €20,000 = €3,000, so no shortfall): taxable €7,000; at an assumed 30% marginal rate, about €2,100.

formulas.title: A simple yearly P&L per home (simulation)
formulas.text:
```
revenue      = Σ booking prices (VAT included)
− vat        = Σ vat (0 if exempt)
− platformFees = Σ price × commission (0 for direct bookings; typed in for a booking platform)
− cleaning, laundry, consumables, utilities, insurance, maintenance, IMI, accounting = typed-in costs
= profit before income tax
− irsAL      (3.3)
= profit after the estimated income tax
touristTax is shown as collected and passed on: never revenue, never cost.
```
